card.name: Start of CYP enzyme names
card.fires_on: The capital letter C that begins CYP right after strong, moderate or sensitive in drug interaction text. Also D in Dose right after Adult in a dosage heading.

modes.label: C of CYP
modes.description: The letter C that starts a CYP enzyme name after a strength word like strong or moderate.

modes.label: D of Dose
modes.description: The letter D that starts Dose after Adult in a dosage section heading.

card.plain: It fires on the first letter of CYP enzyme names, such as CYP3A4, in drug interaction lines, and on the D of Adult Dose.
